info.name: web26a — Backend Trello Clone
info.description:
# Bo API cho do an web26a

## Cai dat 2 phut
1. Import CA HAI file: collection nay + file `web26a-local.postman_environment.json`.
2. Goc tren ben phai Postman: chon environment **web26a - Local**.
3. Chay backend: `cd backend && npm run start:dev`
4. Mo thu muc **0. BAT DAU O DAY** → chay *Dang ky tai khoan test* → xong.

Token tu dong luu, cac request khac dung lai ngay. Khong phai copy tay lan nao.

## Bien tu dong luu
`idToken`, `refreshToken`, `myUid`, `orgId`, `workspaceId`, `boardId`, `listId`, `cardId`, `labelId`, `commentId` — chay request tao xong la
cac request sau tu co id, khong phai dan tay.

## Luu y
- Token song **1 gio**. Bi 401 giua chung → chay *Lam moi token*.
- Moi nguoi dung **email test rieng** de khong dam du lieu nhau.
- Endpoint chua lam se tra ve rong hoac loi — do la binh thuong.

item.name: 0. BAT DAU O DAY — Lay token
item.description:
Moi endpoint cua backend deu doi header `Authorization: Bearer <Firebase ID token>`.

**Lam theo thu tu:**
1. Chay **Dang ky tai khoan test** (chi 1 lan cho moi email).
2. Hoac chay **Dang nhap** neu da co tai khoan.
3. Token tu dong luu vao bien `idToken` — cac request khac dung lai ngay, khong phai copy tay.

**Token het han sau 1 gio** → chay **Lam moi token**, khong phai dang nhap lai.

item.name: 1. Auth — DA XONG (dung lam mau)
item.description:
3 endpoint nay **da hoan thanh**, dung lam mau tham khao khi lam phan cua minh:
- Cach lay user hien tai tu token (`@CurrentUser()`)
- Cach validate body bang DTO (tra 400 khi sai)
- Cach xu ly trung du lieu (tra 409 thay vi 500)

File tham khao: `src/modules/auth/`

item.name: GET /auth/me — ho so + danh sach to chuc

request.description:
Tra ve ho so user + cac to chuc user thuoc ve + co `needsOnboarding`.
Goi lan dau se TU TAO dong trong bang `users`.

Body TUY CHON. Chi dien khi o do dang trong — dang nhap lai KHONG ghi de
du lieu user da tu sua.

Sua ho so. Username trung → 409. Sai dinh dang → 400.
Khong doi duoc `email` qua day (Firebase quan ly email).

role nhan 1 trong 3: 'owner' | 'admin' | 'member'.

⚠️ Moi to chuc chi duoc DUNG 1 owner (unique index uniq_org_single_owner):
   phong owner cho nguoi khac thi phai ha owner cu xuong 'admin'.

owner hoac admin goi duoc. member goi → 403.
Khong cho xoa chinh owner cua to chuc.
